title: Outkast Teams Up with the Georgia Bulldogs for a New Nike Collection
summary: Here's how to shop 'so fresh, so clean' merch and apparel online — the collection starts at $45.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With the upcoming Atlanta Gridiron Classic rivalry college football game, Florida Gators vs. Georgia Bulldogs, on Saturday (Oct. 31), iconic Atlanta rap duo Outkast partners with the University of Georgia for a new collection with Nike .

Prices start at $45 with “so fresh, so clean” merch and apparel that features t-shirts, hoodies, hats, bomber jackets and other items. In fact, there’s even a stylish rugby polo long-sleeve shirt that features the Outkast x UGA logo, which ideal for game day. It also features the year 1996 for the 30th anniversary of the duo’s classic album ATLiens , which was originally released in August 1996.

Shop nike x uga x outkast at Nike

In addition, you can get free shipping on orders of $50 or more, if you’re a Nike Member . Otherwise, your order has to be over $75 for free shipping.

Meanwhile, last-minute tickets to the Florida-Georgia game at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia are still available at affordable prices from third-party retailers, like StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime and others.

If you can’t attend the college game in person, you can watch Florida vs. Georgia game live on ABC for free with free trials from DirecTV , Hulu + Live , YouTube TV and other streaming platforms. Kickoff has a start time of 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT.
